headline: Dead Lands Toll Mounts as Seventeenth Day Grinds On
war_summary: The ledger of the Dead Lands grows heavier by the hour. Since our last edition the region's dead have risen to ten thousand five hundred Colonial and eleven thousand eight hundred Warden names, with fresh base activity logged as recently as this morning; seventeen events stand recorded across the day at Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow above all, and the balance of strongpoints there has shifted to seven Wardens against four Colonials. Endless Shore remains the day's busiest field with forty-two recorded events around Woodbind, Saltbrook Channel and Wellchurch, though its last entry came hours ago and the front has since gone quiet on current readings. Drowned Vale, which roared overnight at Eastmarch and The Wash, has likewise fallen silent in recent hours. Farranac Coast shows nine bases Colonial to two Warden with warden losses accelerating sharply, while Loch Mor bleeds heavily at Westmarch and Market Road and Marban Hollow's toll is climbing fast despite a thin six-to-two Colonial edge. Weathered Expanse counts enormous casualties without a single recorded base movement. Elsewhere the map holds firm: rear provinces from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors, and thirty-four victory towns are required before any victor may be declared.
